title: 第七章 鹰城长风  破壁明空第八章 北望明灯  雏鹰初鸣

天圆地方，风止之城。穿越沙海，三人终于踏上了坚实的石板路。远方，数座高耸入云的巨大风车如同沉默的巨人，扇叶凝固在倾斜的角度——自从神兽青鹰被魔化，鹰城的风便死了，河水断流，生机枯寂。
城门口，没有预想中的守卫或魔兽，只有一片令人心慌的死寂。一块被风沙侵蚀的界碑旁，鹰捷蹲下身，抹去浮尘，露出下面新鲜的刻痕——俄磊的密语。
“风眼在心，非目所及；破壁非力，唯明可净。”鹰捷低声解读，胖乎乎的脸上满是凝重，
“意思是，关键在青鹰本身，它被魔化后形成的防御如同‘心之壁垒’，蛮力难破，必须用对方法才能‘净化’。”话音刚落，一阵不祥的烈风毫无征兆地从城门内狂涌而出！
风中，一个庞大如小山的青色身影缓缓升起，正是魔兵兽·青鹰！它双目赤红如血，翎羽边缘缠绕着紫黑色的魔气，双翼展开，投下的阴影几乎将三人完全吞噬。
在它面前，空气都仿佛变得粘稠、沉重。一个身影从城门内的阴影中走出，正是罗正。
他脸上挂着嘲弄的冷笑：“恭候多时了，小子们。魔盟主大人有令，鹰城，就是你们的终点。青鹰，让他们见识见识，什么叫真正的‘不动壁垒’！”第一合：太极统·万象破坚罗正并不急于让青鹰变身，他要先彻底碾碎这群孩子的抵抗意志。
青鹰赤目一闪，双翼猛振，并非攻击，而是引动了天地间的风元力！无数道近乎实质的、高速旋转的青色风罡凭空生成，层层叠叠，环绕在青鹰与罗正周围，形成一个密不透风的绝对防御领域——风罡铁壁！
罡风呼啸，切割空气发出刺耳尖啸，地面的石板被逸散的力量刮出道道白痕。
“任何攻击，都会被这风罡搅碎！”罗正狂笑。鹰捷上前一步，将台灵护在身后，同时将沉重的太极统从背上解下，双手稳稳持握。
这件得自甘泉镇地下的宝物，其核心是
“炼假成真”与
“化不可能为可能”的信念之力。他心念急转，回忆俄磊密语中隐约提及的此宝潜能。
“硬的能软，实的能虚——破甲流火！”他观想穿透与融化的意象，扣动扳机。
太极统两端阴阳鱼转动，炮口喷涌而出的并非普通火焰，而是一道凝练无比、呈现亮白色的高温射流，如同焊枪的光焰，直刺风罡壁垒。
射流与风罡剧烈摩擦，发出令人牙酸的滋滋声，竟将最外层的几道风罡生生
“烧”出缺口，但更深层的风罡迅速补位，缺口很快弥合。
“雕虫小技！”罗正冷哼。鹰捷不答，信念再变：“刚的能柔，动者易折——凝冰迟滞！”炮口光芒转为冰蓝，射出的是一蓬极寒的、带着无数细微冰晶的冻气云雾。
云雾笼罩部分风罡，超低温虽未冻结狂暴的能量，却显著降低了风罡的旋转速度，使其变得迟滞、可见。

罗正眉头微皱，这胖小子的古怪兵器有点门道。他正要催动青鹰反击，鹰捷的第三次变化已至！
鹰捷额头见汗，但眼神亮得惊人。他将对伙伴的守护之意、对收复家园的渴望，全部灌注于信念：“守护之念，坚不可摧——贯岳一击！”这一次，太极统发出低沉轰鸣，阴阳鱼逆转，炮口光芒内敛到极致，随后，一道凝实如攻城巨锤般的土黄色能量重锤轰然射出！
它并非元素，而是高度凝聚的
“冲击”与
“粉碎”信念的具现！
“砰——！！！”重锤狠狠砸在因冻气而迟滞的风罡壁垒同一位置！冰火交替削弱后的防御，在这纯粹的巨力冲击下，终于发出不堪重负的碎裂声！
风罡铁壁被砸开一个明显的、短时间内难以修复的缺口！
“就是现在！”鹰捷力竭，大口喘息，太极统也光芒黯淡下去。他后退两步，更加警觉地护在台灵身前。
第二合：借力·身随风舞缺口出现，但青鹰本体仍在，魔威凛然。台焕知道，此刻道晶兽未变身，自己无法调用其
“公道”转化的元素力量。但他看到了太极统攻击后，空气中残留的、尚未完全散去的活跃元素气息（冰晶、灼热、震荡波），以及青鹰周身被搅乱的、狂暴的风元力。
“鹰捷，护好灵儿！”台焕低喝一声，瘦削的身影已如猎豹般窜出！他没有冲向青鹰，而是冲向那被太极统打开的能量混乱区域。
九字真言自他心底流过，台焕将自身武道意志与感知提升到极致。他并非调用体内力量（此刻并无冰属性），而是以自身为媒介，以精妙的武技身法为引导，去借用、裹挟、牵引周遭环境中那些被太极统打散和激荡的元力！
他足尖连点，身形如风中柳絮，又似穿花蝴蝶，在紊乱的能量流中穿梭。
右手虚引，将一缕灼热气息纳入掌风；左手轻拂，带动几点冰晶寒芒；身形旋转间，更将道道散乱风刃的气流扰动向特定方向。
这不是法术，而是顶尖武者对天地能量韵律的极致感知与运用，是
“身随剑舞”境界的另一种体现——身与力合，借力打力！数息之间，他竟以自身为核心，暂时凝聚起一团混杂着冰、火、风、冲击余波的小型能量漩涡，虽然驳杂不稳定，却散发着不容小觑的狂暴气息。
“去！”台焕清叱，将这团借来的、不稳定的能量漩涡，全力推向青鹰！
罗正没料到对方还有这一手，急忙喝道：“青鹰，震散它！”青鹰尖啸，双翼向前合拢，试图以更狂暴的风压将这团杂糅的能量提前引爆。
第三合：神兵决·玄冰净魔就在能量漩涡与青鹰风压即将对撞的瞬间！
台焕等待的就是这一刻的僵持与空隙！

“道晶兽，变身！”他声如金石，掷地有声，
“变身神兵，道晶！公道之力！”金光乍现，道晶剑已然在手！剑身晶莹，寒气自生——这一次的冰寒，并非借用外界，而是源于神兵兽本源

The sky is round and the earth is round, the city where the wind stops. After crossing the sand sea, the three finally set foot on a solid stone road. In the distance, several huge windmills towering into the clouds are like silent giants, their fan blades frozen at a tilted angle - ever since the mythical beast Green Eagle was demonized, the wind in Eagle City has died, the river has stopped flowing, and the vitality has dried up.
At the city gate, there were no guards or monsters as expected, just a panic-stricken silence. Next to a boundary monument that was eroded by wind and sand, Yingjie squatted down and wiped away the dust, revealing fresh carvings underneath - Orei's secret message.
"The eye of the wind is in the heart, it cannot be seen; it is not strength that can break the wall, it can only be purified by light." Ying Jie explained in a low voice, his chubby face full of solemnity,
"It means that the key lies in the green eagle itself. The defense formed by it after being demonized is like a 'barrier of the heart'. It is difficult to break through with brute force. It must be 'purified' with the right method." As soon as he finished speaking, an ominous strong wind rushed out from the city gate without any warning!
In the wind, a green figure as big as a hill slowly rose up. It was the Demonic Weapon Beast, Green Eagle! Its eyes were as red as blood, and the edges of its feathers were entangled with purple-black demonic energy. Its wings spread out, casting a shadow that almost completely swallowed the three of them.
In front of it, the air seemed to become thick and heavy. A figure walked out of the shadows inside the city gate, it was Luo Zheng.
There was a mocking sneer on his face: "I've been waiting for you for a long time, boys. The Lord of the Demon Alliance has ordered that Eagle City is your destination. Qingying, let them see what a real 'immovable barrier' is!" The first combination: Taijitong·Wanxiang Pojian Luo Zheng is not in a hurry to let Qingying transform. He wants to completely crush the resistance of these children.
Qing Ying's red eyes flashed, and his wings flapped sharply. It was not an attack, but it aroused the wind energy between heaven and earth! Countless almost substantial, high-speed rotating cyan wind gangs were generated out of thin air, layered on top of each other, surrounding Qingying and Luo Zheng, forming an airtight and absolute defense field - the Feng Gang Iron Wall!
The strong wind roared, cutting the air with a harsh scream, and the stone slabs on the ground were scraped with white marks by the escaping force.
"Any attack will be shattered by this wind!" Luo Zheng laughed wildly. Ying Jie took a step forward, guarding Tai Ling behind him, and at the same time took off the heavy Tai Chi system from his back, holding it firmly with both hands.
The core of this treasure obtained from the underground of Ganquan Town is
"Refining falsehood to become true" and
The power of faith to "turn the impossible into possible". His mind raced, recalling the potential of this treasure vaguely mentioned in Orei's secret language.
"What's hard can be soft, what's real can be empty - armor-piercing fire!" He visualized the image of penetration and melting, and pulled the trigger.
The yin and yang fish at both ends of the Tai Chi system rotated, and what spewed out from the muzzle was not an ordinary flame, but an extremely condensed, bright white high-temperature jet, like the flame of a welding gun, piercing the Feng Gang barrier.
The jets and wind gangs rubbed violently, making a tooth-gripping sizzling sound, which actually caused the outermost wind gangs to come into being.
A gap was "burned", but the deeper Feng Gang quickly filled the gap, and the gap was quickly closed.
"Little trick!" Luo Zheng snorted coldly. Yingjie did not answer, but his belief changed again: "What is strong can be softened, but what moves is easy to break - frozen ice is sluggish!" The light from the muzzle turned to ice blue, and what was shot out was a cloud of extremely cold freezing air with countless tiny ice crystals.
Clouds and fog covered part of Feng Gang. Although the ultra-low temperature did not freeze the violent energy, it significantly reduced the rotation speed of Feng Gang, making it sluggish and visible.
Luo Zheng frowned slightly, this fat boy had some tricks up his sleeve. He was about to urge Qing Ying to counterattack when Ying Jie's third change had arrived!
Ying Jie had sweat on his forehead, but his eyes were surprisingly bright. He poured all his love to protect his friends and his desire to regain his homeland into his belief: "The thought of protection is indestructible - a strike from Guanyue!" This time, Tai Chi System let out a low roar, the Yin and Yang fish reversed, the muzzle light was restrained to the extreme, and then, a heavy hammer of khaki energy that was as solid as a siege hammer suddenly shot out!
It is not an element;is highly condensed
"impact" and
The embodiment of "shattering" belief!
"Bang——!!!" The heavy hammer hit the same position of the Feng Gang Barrier that was sluggish due to the freezing air! The defense, weakened by the alternation of ice and fire, finally made an overwhelming sound of shattering under the sheer force of the impact!
Feng Gang's iron wall was smashed open with an obvious gap that was difficult to repair in a short time!
"That's it now!" Ying Jie was exhausted and gasping for breath, and the light of the Tai Chi system dimmed. He took two steps back and guarded Tai Ling more vigilantly.
The second combination: Borrowing strength and dancing with the wind, the gap appears, but the green eagle's body is still there, with awe-inspiring demonic power. Tai Huan knew that at this moment, the Dao Crystal Beast had not transformed and he could not use it.
The elemental power of "justice" transformation. But he saw the active elemental aura (ice crystals, scorching heat, shock waves) that remained in the air after the Taiji system attack and had not completely dissipated, as well as the chaotic and violent wind energy around Qingying.
"Yingjie, protect Ling'er!" Tai Huan shouted, and his thin figure jumped out like a cheetah! He did not rush towards Qingying, but towards the chaotic area of ​​energy opened by Tai Chi.
The nine-character mantra flowed from the bottom of his heart, and Tai Huan raised his martial arts will and perception to the extreme. He is not using the power in his body (there is no ice attribute at the moment), but using himself as a medium and using exquisite martial arts as a guide to borrow, coerce, and pull the energy in the surrounding environment that has been dispersed and stirred up by Tai Chi!
His toes are pointed, and his body shape is like catkins in the wind, or like a butterfly piercing flowers, shuttling in the chaotic energy flow.
The right hand was used to draw a wisp of hot breath into the palm wind; the left hand flicked to bring out a few ice crystals of cold light; while the body was rotating, the airflow of the scattered wind blades was disturbed in a specific direction.
This is not a spell, but a top warrior's ultimate perception and application of the energy rhythm of heaven and earth.
Another manifestation of the realm of "dancing with the sword" - combining the body with the force, leveraging the force to fight! In a few breaths, he used himself as the core to temporarily condense a small energy vortex mixed with ice, fire, wind, and the aftermath of the impact. Although it was mixed and unstable, it exuded a violent aura that should not be underestimated.
"Go!" Tai Huanqing scolded, pushing this borrowed, unstable energy vortex towards Qingying with all his strength!
Luo Zheng did not expect that the other party had such a hand, and shouted hurriedly: "Green Eagle, shake it away!" The Green Eagle screamed, folding its wings forward, trying to detonate this mixed energy in advance with more violent wind pressure.
The third round: Divine Weapon Art·Xuan Bing Demon Purification is at the moment when the energy vortex and the blue eagle wind pressure are about to collide!
What Tai Huan was waiting for was this moment of stalemate and gap!
"Dao Crystal Beast, transform!" His voice was as loud as gold and stone, and it hit the ground.
"Transform into a divine weapon, Dao Jing! The power of justice!" Golden light suddenly appeared, and the Dao Jing Sword was already in hand! The sword body is crystal clear, and the cold air is generated by itself - this time the coldness is not borrowed from the outside world, but comes from the origin of the divine weapon beast.
